metrics.name: dismissal_rate
metrics.why: Clinical decision support override rates exceed 85%. Alert fatigue is operationalized as declining appropriate-response rate, not alert count. This is the primary metric and the one that decides whether presence stays installed.

metrics.name: action_rate
metrics.definition: surfaces that led to an action / total surfaces shown
metrics.why: A surface that is neither acted on nor dismissed is wallpaper. Wallpaper is the failure mode that looks like success.

metrics.name: interrupt_volume
metrics.definition: surfaces per waking hour, and per day
metrics.why: Mark 2008: throttle cumulative volume, because the cost accumulates and no plateau was established. Relevance does not raise this cap.

metrics.name: time_to_know
metrics.definition: minutes from a real event existing on disk to a surface about it
metrics.why: The whole point of push. If this is not materially better than Caleb noticing on his own, the system has no reason to exist.

metrics.name: wrongness_rate
metrics.definition: surfaces about something already done or untrue / total
metrics.why: Caleb's stated tolerance is two bad interrupts. A false positive costs trust across every future surface; a false negative costs one event.

metrics.name: repeat_suppression
metrics.definition: identical finding shown twice without worsening
metrics.why: hud-watch already fingerprints and gates on escalation. Any nonzero value means that gate broke.

cases.prompt: an assignment is due in 2 days and not done
cases.expect_behavior: one surface, inside the hourly budget, carrying its source

cases.prompt: the same assignment, still due in 2 days, nothing changed
cases.expect_behavior: silence, because the escalation gate requires it to have worsened

cases.prompt: the same assignment, now due today
an interesting but non-actionable fact about a contact
cases.why: relevance does not buy an interruption (Mark 2008, rule 7)

cases.prompt: three findings all qualify within the same hour
cases.expect_behavior: the worst one only, then silence until the budget resets
log once, exit non-zero, do not retry in a loop

cases.prompt: Caleb dismisses the same finding class twice
cases.expect_behavior: suppress that class for 7 days without being asked

cases.why: voice is transient and unscannable; status is never the hands-and-eyes-busy imperative case (rule 16)
